overall_reason: The only pictures are two product illustrations built for this product, the phone log in the hero and the medicine record table, and both carry specific, consistent farm data; the drawn phone bezel is the one stand-in.

score.reason: T-ILLUSTRATION-READ and T-ONE-REGISTER pass on the two product illustrations and the letter-tile icons, but T-STAND-IN finds a CSS-drawn phone bezel and the hero log's weekday does not match the 2026 record (IMG-005, IMG-007).

findings.title: No drawn stand-ins for real things
findings.where: hero, right column, about x 877 to 1186 and y 141 to 583 of the 1440 image
findings.evidence: The hero product picture is a phone drawn in CSS: a dark rounded bezel about 310 by 440px with a drop shadow, wrapped around four log entries and a yellow '+ Add entry' button. The page sells a working phone app ('Log movements, medicines and field work from your phone'), so the real log screen could have been captured.
findings.before: A drawn phone bezel framing a hand-built copy of the log screen.
findings.after: A capture of the real Hill Farm log screen at 2x, shown without a drawn device frame, or the same illustration without the bezel so it reads as an illustration (C48).
findings.why: A drawn device frame claims to show the app on a phone while showing a mock; a capture shows the visitor the screen they will use in the yard.

findings.title: A product illustration is built to be read
findings.where: hero phone illustration, header strip, about x 905 and y 180 of the 1440 image
findings.evidence: The phone header reads 'Tuesday 21 October'. The medicine record table in section 3 is dated 'Jul to Oct 2026' and lists a Wormer dose on 21 Oct. 21 October 2026 is a Wednesday, so the two illustrations disagree about the year or the day.
findings.after: 'Wednesday 21 October', so the hero log and the medicine record describe the same day in 2026.
findings.why: The illustrations earn trust through exact farm detail (batch 4471, 21-day withdrawal that clears on 11 Nov); one wrong weekday is the detail a farmer checking dates will notice.

strengths: The two product illustrations use specific, cross-checked data: the hero's 'Wormer, batch 4471, 8 lambs, 21 day withdrawal' matches the medicine record row 'Wormer, Lambs, 8, 21 Oct, clear 11 Nov' (21 days).
One icon system: the MV, RX and FW letter tiles in the phone log are the same tiles that head the three feature cards, and the section 3 list uses one green check glyph.
No stock photographs, illustration packs, orbs or gradient art anywhere on the page.
not_investigated: image-only item: natural sizes, hosts, file names, alt text, density, crops at 375 and the sweep's per-element hits (fake_people, img_alt, mixed_icons, emoji_icons, icon_tile, gradient, glow, performance) were not captured; T-IMAGE-SIZE and T-CROP-375 were judged only from what the one image shows
the whole artifact is one screenshot, so it is one sample; confidence is medium at most
licences and credits: the capture cannot see licences
menus, carousels, tabs, hover states and lazy content: no interaction was captured
art direction at other widths: only one width exists
T-CAPTURE-READ: no product capture; both product pictures are illustrations, judged with T-ILLUSTRATION-READ (C48)
